quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.intro: Add several buys at once. They are saved together: if one row has a problem, nothing is saved. To spread an amount, fill in the amount and a share for each row, then press Split the amount; you can still change the units.
quickAdd.amountHint: Optional. Only used by Split the amount.

errors.empty: Fill in at least one row.
errors.units: Row {{n}}: enter whole units, at least 1.
errors.price: Row {{n}}: enter the price paid, more than zero.
errors.fees: Row {{n}}: the fees must be a number.

reconcile.title: Reconcile with your broker
reconcile.intro: Paste the holdings your broker shows for a date, one per line with the ISIN and the number of units. Folio lists the differences with its own records. Nothing is changed.
reconcile.pasteHint: An ISIN and a quantity on each line, separated by a tab, semicolon or spaces.
reconcile.nothing: Paste at least one line with an ISIN and a quantity.

reports.disclaimer: These figures come straight from your transactions and the lots they used. They support your tax return; they are not tax advice, and the rules that apply to you are yours to check.

empty.title: No reports yet
empty.body: Reports appear once you have recorded a sale, a dividend or interest.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.help: Every posted transaction, one row each, in the layout the import wizard recognises: import the file again (into a new account, for example) and the positions come out the same.

positions.title: Positions
positions.help: The open positions with their cost basis, market value and last close.
